add_application_hiring_team_member.title: application.addHiringTeamMember
add_application_hiring_team_member.description: Adds an Ashby user to the hiring team at the application level.
add_application_hiring_team_member.notes: The API key needs the candidatesWrite permission.

application_id.description: The application to assign the user a role on.

team_member_id.description: The id of the user to assign the role to.

role_id.description: The id of the hiring team role to assign.

add_assessment_completed_to_candidate.title: assessment.addCompletedToCandidate
add_assessment_completed_to_candidate.description: Add a completed assessment to a candidate.
add_assessment_completed_to_candidate.notes: The API key needs the candidatesWrite permission.

candidate_id.description: The id of the candidate to whom to add the completed assessment

partner_id.description: The id of the partner adding the assessment

timestamp.description: The timestamp in milliseconds since the unix epoch when the assessment was completed

add_candidate_email_message.title: candidate.addEmailMessage
add_candidate_email_message.description: Attaches an existing email message (e.g. fetched from a partner provider) to a candidate.
add_candidate_email_message.notes: The API key needs the candidatesWrite permission.

candidate_id.description: The candidate to attach this email to

email_provider_email_id.description: Unique identifier for this message in the partner system. Must be unique per API key.

body.description: The html body of the email

user_id.description: The Ashby user ID to associate with this email. Defaults to the API key user.

sent_at.description: When the email was sent. Defaults to the current time.

message_url.description: URL to view the message in the partner application

thread_id.description: Thread identifier to group this message with others. Defaults to emailProviderEmailId.

is_private.description: Whether the email should be marked as private. Private emails require "Allow access to non-offer private fields?" API key permission to create and view. Defaults to false.

add_candidate_project.title: candidate.addProject
add_candidate_project.description: Adds a candidate to a project. Calls Ashby's candidate.addProject endpoint.
add_candidate_project.notes: The API key needs the candidatesWrite permission.

candidate_id.description: The id of the candidate

add_candidate_tag.title: candidate.addTag
add_candidate_tag.description: Adds a tag to a candidate. Calls Ashby's candidate.addTag endpoint.
add_candidate_tag.notes: The API key needs the candidatesWrite permission.

candidate_id.description: The unique id of the candidate to add the tag to

tag_id.description: The unique id of the tag to add to the candidate

add_hiring_team_member.title: hiringTeam.addMember
add_hiring_team_member.description: Adds an Ashby user to the hiring team at the application, job, or opening level.
add_hiring_team_member.notes: The API key needs the organizationWrite permission.

application_id.description: The application to assign the user a role on

job_id.description: The job to assign the user a role on

opening_id.description: The opening to assign the user a role on

team_member_id.description: The id of the user to assign the role to

role_id.description: The id of the hiring team role to assign

add_interviewer_pool_user.title: interviewerPool.addUser
add_interviewer_pool_user.description: Add a user to an interviewer pool. Calls Ashby's interviewerPool.addUser endpoint.
add_interviewer_pool_user.notes: The API key needs the hiringProcessMetadataWrite permission.

interviewer_pool_id.description: The id of the interviewer pool

user_id.description: The id of the user to add to the interviewer pool

interviewer_pool_training_path_stage_id.description: The id of the training path stage to add the user to. If this is not provided, the user will be added as a fully qualified member of the pool.

add_opening_job.title: opening.addJob
add_opening_job.description: Adds a job to an opening. Calls Ashby's opening.addJob endpoint.
add_opening_job.notes: The API key needs the jobsWrite permission.

job_id.description: The id of the job to add to the opening

add_opening_location.title: opening.addLocation
add_opening_location.description: Adds a location to an opening. Calls Ashby's opening.addLocation endpoint.
add_opening_location.notes: The API key needs the jobsWrite permission.

location_id.description: The id of the location to add to the opening

add_sequence.title: sequence.add
add_sequence.description: Enrolls a candidate in a reusable sourcing sequence. Set start to false to create an editable draft, or true to validate and start the sequence immediately. The optional applicationId fixes the application used for token resolution. The optional from.email must be a Primary, PersonalAlias, or OrganizationAlias address returned by emailSender.list for the same acting user.
add_sequence.notes: The API key needs the sourcingWrite permission.

sequence_template_id.description: The reusable sourcing sequence template to use

candidate_id.description: The candidate to enroll in the sequence

application_id.description: The candidate's application to use for token resolution

from.description: The sending address to use for every email stage

start.description: Whether to validate and start the sequence immediately after creating it

anonymize_candidate.title: candidate.anonymize
anonymize_candidate.description: Anonymizes a candidate's personally identifiable information.
anonymize_candidate.notes: The API key needs the candidatesWrite permission.

candidate_id.description: The id of the candidate to anonymize

approve_offer.title: offer.approve
approve_offer.description: Approves an offer or a specific approval step within an offer's approval process. This endpoint mimics the behavior of the "Force Approve" function in the Ashby app, where an admin can override approval for a specific step or entire approval process. This endpoint can be used in two ways: 1.
approve_offer.notes: The API key needs the offersWrite permission.

offer_version_id.description: The id of the offer version that needs approval. This can be obtained as the entityId from the approval.list endpoint.

approval_step_id.description: The id of the specific approval step to approve. If provided, userId must also be provided. If omitted, the entire offer approval process will be approved. This can be obtained from the approval.list endpoint.

user_id.description: The id of the user approving the step. Required if approvalStepId is provided. Must be an approver for the specified approval step.

comment.description: An optional comment to record with the approval. Only supported when approvalStepId and userId are provided.

exclude_form_definition.description: If true, omit the form definition from the response.

archive_candidate_tag.title: candidateTag.archive
archive_candidate_tag.description: Archives a candidate tag. Calls Ashby's candidateTag.archive endpoint.
archive_candidate_tag.notes: The API key needs the hiringProcessMetadataWrite permission.

archive_department.title: department.archive
archive_department.description: Archives a department. Calls Ashby's department.archive endpoint.
archive_department.notes: The API key needs the organizationWrite permission.

archive_interviewer_pool.title: interviewerPool.archive
archive_interviewer_pool.description: Archives an interviewer pool. Calls Ashby's interviewerPool.archive endpoint.
archive_interviewer_pool.notes: The API key needs the hiringProcessMetadataWrite permission.

interviewer_pool_id.description: The id of the interviewer pool to archive

archive_location.title: location.archive
archive_location.description: Archives a location or location hierarchy.
archive_location.notes: The API key needs the organizationWrite permission.

archive_project.title: project.archive
archive_project.description: Beta This endpoint is in beta and may not be available for all organizations. Archives a project. The effective actor must have permission to edit the project, including authorized on-behalf-of requests. Calling this endpoint on an already archived project succeeds. Candidate memberships, history, authorship, confidentiality, descriptions, and custom-field values are preserved.
archive_project.notes: The API key needs the projectsWrite permission.

cancel_assessment.title: assessment.cancel
cancel_assessment.description: (Optional) Cancels an assessment. Implemented by the partner, called by Ashby.

cancel_interview_schedule.title: interviewSchedule.cancel
cancel_interview_schedule.description: Cancel an interview schedule by id. Calls Ashby's interviewSchedule.cancel endpoint.
cancel_interview_schedule.notes: The API key needs the interviewsWrite permission.

id.description: The id of the interview schedule to cancel

allow_reschedule.description: Whether or not this interview schedule can be rescheduled.

cancel_sequence.title: sequence.cancel
cancel_sequence.description: Cancels a running sourcing sequence (campaign) for a candidate. Requires one of the candidatesWrite or sourcingWrite permissions.

sequence_id.description: The id of the sequence to cancel

reason.description: The reason for cancelling the sequence. Defaults to booked_meeting.

change_application_source.title: application.changeSource
change_application_source.description: Change the source of an application. Calls Ashby's application.changeSource endpoint.
change_application_source.notes: The API key needs the candidatesWrite permission.

application_id.description: The id of the application to update the source of.

source_id.description: The source to set on the application. Pass null to unset an application's source.

change_application_stage.title: application.changeStage
change_application_stage.description: Change the stage of an application. Calls Ashby's application.changeStage endpoint.
change_application_stage.notes: The API key needs the candidatesWrite permission.

application_id.description: The id of the application to update the stage of.

interview_stage_id.description: The interview stage to move the application to.

archive_reason_id.description: Archive Reason to set when moving to an Interview Stage with type Archived. Required when moving to an Archived stage.

create_application.title: application.create
create_application.description: Consider a candidate for a job (e.g. when sourcing a candidate for a job posting). If you're submitting an application as a job board, use the applicationForm.submit endpoint instead. See Creating a custom careers page for details. To set values for custom fields on Applications, use the customField.setValue endpoint.
create_application.notes: The API key needs the candidatesWrite permission.

candidate_id.description: The id of the candidate to consider for a job.

job_id.description: The id of the job to consider the candidate for.

interview_plan_id.description: The id of the interview plan to place the application in. If none is provided, the default interview plan is used.

interview_stage_id.description: The interview stage of the interview plan to place the application in. If none is provided, the application is placed in the first "Lead" stage.

source_id.description: The source to set on the application being created.

credited_to_user_id.description: The id of the user the application will be credited to.

created_at.description: An ISO date string to set the application's createdAt timestamp. Defaults to the time the call was made when not provided.

application_history.description: An array of objects representing the application history. When provided, the application is created with the supplied history events.

create_application_feedback_request.title: applicationFeedbackRequest.create
create_application_feedback_request.description: Request feedback on an application without scheduling an interview. The interviewEventId returned in the response can be provided to applicationFeedback.submit to complete the feedback request. The interview used must be configured to request feedback.
create_application_feedback_request.notes: The API key needs the candidatesWrite permission.

application_id.description: The id of the application you are requesting feedback for

interview_id.description: The id of the interview associated with this feedback request

interviewer_user_id.description: The user you are requesting feedback from

create_candidate.title: candidate.create
create_candidate.description: Creates a new candidate. Calls Ashby's candidate.create endpoint.
create_candidate.notes: The API key needs the candidatesWrite permission.

name.description: The first and last name of the candidate to be created

email.description: Primary, personal email of the candidate to be created

phone_number.description: Primary, personal phone number of the candidate to be created

linked_in_url.description: Url to the candidate's LinkedIn profile. Must be a valid Url.

github_url.description: Url to the candidate's Github profile. Must be a valid Url.

website.description: Url of the candidate's website. Must be a valid Url.

alternate_email_addresses.description: Array of alternate email addresses to add to the candidate's profile

source_id.description: The source to set on the candidate being created

credited_to_user_id.description: The id of the user the candidate will be credited to

created_at.description: An ISO date string to set the candidate's createdAt timestamp. When this value isn't provided, the createdAt timestamp defaults to the time the call was made.

create_candidate_note.title: candidate.createNote
create_candidate_note.description: Creates a note on a candidate. Calls Ashby's candidate.createNote endpoint.
create_candidate_note.notes: The API key needs the candidatesWrite permission.

candidate_id.description: The id of the candidate

note.description: The note to add to the candidate. Either a plain string, or an object { type, value } where type is text/plain or text/html.

send_notifications.description: Whether or not users who are subscribed to the candidate should be notified that the note was posted. Default is false.

is_private.description: Whether the note should be marked as private. Private notes require "Allow access to non-offer private fields?" API key permission to create and view. Default is false.

created_at.description: An ISO date string to set the note's createdAt timestamp

create_candidate_tag.title: candidateTag.create
create_candidate_tag.description: Creates a candidate tag. If a tag already exists with the given title, the existing tag will be returned.
create_candidate_tag.notes: The API key needs the hiringProcessMetadataWrite permission.

title.description: The tag's title. If a tag already exists with that title, the existing tag will be returned.

create_custom_field.title: customField.create
create_custom_field.description: Create a new custom field. Project custom fields do not support Currency, NumberRange, or CompensationRange. Job and opening custom fields can be configured so their values are editable only through the API when this capability is enabled for the organization.
create_custom_field.notes: The API key needs the hiringProcessMetadataWrite permission.

field_type.description: The type of field being created. This value is case-sensitive.

object_type.description: The type of object the field can be associated with.

selectable_values.description: Required when the field type is ValueSelect or MultiValueSelect. An array of selectable values for the field.

is_date_only_field.description: Only applies to fields with a fieldType of Date. Whether or not the field includes content other than a date.

is_exposable_to_candidate.description: Determines whether the field can be exposed to a candidate in certain contexts. In order for a custom field to be available in an email template this value must be true.

is_private.description: Whether the custom field should be private.

is_editable_only_via_public_api.description: Whether the custom field's value can only be edited through the API. Supported for Job and Opening custom fields when enabled for the organization.

create_department.title: department.create
create_department.description: Creates a department. Calls Ashby's department.create endpoint.
create_department.notes: The API key needs the organizationWrite permission.

name.description: The name of the department or team

external_name.description: An alternate candidate-facing name for this department that will be used on Ashby job boards

parent_id.description: The id of the department's parent department

extra_data.description: Key-value pairs for your own use and reference. Keys must be at most 100 characters, values at most 512 characters, and total size less than 1kb.

create_email_sync_blocked_address.title: emailSyncBlockedAddress.create
create_email_sync_blocked_address.description: Adds email addresses to the candidate email sync blocklist. Matching ignores case but is otherwise exact, so person+tag@example.com is blocked separately from person@example.com. A malformed address rejects the whole batch. An address already on the list returns its existing entry.
create_email_sync_blocked_address.notes: The API key needs the organizationWrite permission.

addresses.description: The email addresses to add to the blocklist. A malformed address rejects the whole batch.

create_file_upload_handle.title: file.createFileUploadHandle
create_file_upload_handle.description: Creates a presigned upload URL that allows uploading a file directly to storage, bypassing the need to send file bytes through the API. The presigned URL expires after 10 minutes. The fileUploadContext must be one of CandidateResume, CandidateFiles, or ApplicationForm.
create_file_upload_handle.notes: The API key needs the candidatesWrite permission.

file_upload_context.description: The context for the file upload

filename.description: The name of the file being uploaded, including extension

content_type.description: The MIME type of the file being uploaded

content_length.description: The size of the file in bytes

create_interview_schedule.title: interviewSchedule.create
create_interview_schedule.description: Create a scheduled interview in Ashby. Calls Ashby's interviewSchedule.create endpoint.
create_interview_schedule.notes: The API key needs the interviewsWrite permission.

application_id.description: The id of the application for this interview schedule

interview_events.description: The list of events that make up this interview schedule

create_interviewer_pool.title: interviewerPool.create
create_interviewer_pool.description: Create an interviewer pool. Calls Ashby's interviewerPool.create endpoint.
create_interviewer_pool.notes: The API key needs the hiringProcessMetadataWrite permission.

title.description: The title of the interviewer pool

requires_training.description: Whether the interviewer pool requires training

create_job.title: job.create
create_job.description: Creates a new job. Calls Ashby's job.create endpoint.
create_job.notes: The API key needs the jobsWrite permission.

team_id.description: The id of the department or team associated with the job

location_id.description: The id of the location associated with the job

default_interview_plan_id.description: The id of the default interview plan for this job. A job cannot be opened without a default interview plan.

job_template_id.description: The id of the job template to use for this job. Only active job templates can be used to create a job.

employment_type.description: The employment type for the job. When omitted, inherits from the job template or defaults to FullTime.

brand_id.description: The id of the brand to use for this job

create_job_posting.title: jobPosting.create
create_job_posting.description: Creates a new job posting for the specified job. Only jobId is required. When title is omitted the posting inherits the parent job's title. When status is omitted the posting is created in Draft status. Side effects: - The new posting is always attached to the external job board for the parent job's brand.
create_job_posting.notes: The API key needs the jobsWrite permission.

job_id.description: The id of the job to create a posting for

title.description: The title for the new job posting. If omitted, defaults to the parent job's title.

description.description: An HTML block of the job posting description

status.description: The initial status of the job posting. Defaults to Draft if omitted. A description is required when creating a Published posting.

is_listed.description: Whether the posting should be listed on the job board. Defaults to true and is forced to false when the parent job is confidential.

location_id.description: The id of the primary location for the job posting. If omitted, the posting inherits the parent job's location.

secondary_location_ids.description: The secondary locations for the job posting.

application_form_definition_id.description: The id of the application form definition to use for the posting. If omitted, the organization default form is used.

create_location.title: location.create
create_location.description: Creates a location or location hierarchy.
create_location.notes: The API key needs the organizationWrite permission.

type.description: A Location represents an actual location that jobs and employees can be associated with. A Location Hierarchy is a grouping of locations or other location hierarchies.

parent_location_id.description: The id of the location's parent.

is_remote.description: Whether the location should be labeled as remote. LocationHierarchies cannot be labeled as remote.

workplace_type.description: The type of workplace. LocationHierarchies cannot be labeled with a workplaceType.

external_name.description: An alternate candidate-facing name for this location used on job boards and in the API.

extra_data.description: Structured key-value information for your own use and reference. Do not store personally identifiable information in this field.

create_offer.title: offer.create
create_offer.description: Creates a new Offer Offer forms support a variety of field types. The values accepted for each field depend on the type of field that's being filled out: - Boolean - A boolean value. - Currency - An object in the format { currencyCode: "USD", value: 100000 } where currencyCode is a valid ISO 4217 currency code and value is an integer. - Date - A valid ISO Date string. - Number - An integer.
create_offer.notes: The API key needs the offersWrite permission.

offer_process_id.description: The id of the offer process associated with the offer you're creating. This value is the id included in the response of the offerProcess.start API.

offer_form_id.description: The id of the form associated with the offer. This value is the id included in the response of the offer.start API.

exclude_form_definition.description: If true, omit the form definition from the response.

create_opening.title: opening.create
create_opening.description: Creates an opening. To set values of custom fields on Openings, use the customField.setValue endpoint.
create_opening.notes: The API key needs the jobsWrite permission.

identifier.description: The human-readable identifier of the opening

team_id.description: The id of the department or team associated with the opening

location_ids.description: The ids of the locations associated with the opening

job_ids.description: The ids of the jobs associated with the opening

target_hire_date.description: The date (in YYYY-MM-DD format) by which you intend to hire against this opening

target_start_date.description: The date (in YYYY-MM-DD format) by which you intend someone hired against this opening will start employment

is_backfill.description: Whether this opening is intended to backfill a previous employee

employment_type.description: The employment type for this opening

opening_state.description: The state the opening should be created in. Defaults to Draft. If not Draft, additional validation will be performed.

create_project.title: project.create
create_project.description: Beta This endpoint is in beta and may not be available for all organizations. Creates a project. The effective actor becomes the author, including authorized on-behalf-of requests. Confidential projects are available on Plus, Legacy Plus, and Enterprise plans. Authors retain access to projects they create. Supply initial customFields for every active required Project custom field definition.
create_project.notes: The API key needs the projectsWrite permission.

description.description: The project's description. Omission, null, or empty content leaves it unset.

custom_fields.description: Initial values. Supply every required field. Supports String, LongText, Boolean, Number, Date, ValueSelect, MultiValueSelect, Url and User fields. Requires Project custom fields availability.

confidential.description: Whether the project is confidential. Defaults to false. Requires confidential project availability.

create_referral.title: referral.create
create_referral.description: Creates a referral Calls Ashby's referral.create endpoint.
create_referral.notes: The API key needs the candidatesWrite permission.

id.description: The id of the referral form, from /referralForm.info

credited_to_user_id.description: The id of the user submitting the referral

field_submissions.description: The field submissions for the referral form

created_at.description: An ISO date string to set the referral's createdAt timestamp to. When this value isn't provided, the createdAt timestamp defaults to the time the referral was created.

create_survey_request.title: surveyRequest.create
create_survey_request.description: This endpoint generates a survey request and returns a survey URL. You can send this URL to a candidate to allow them to complete a survey. Note that calling this endpoint will not automatically email the survey to the candidate. It simply creates the request and gives you a URL to share with a candidate.
create_survey_request.notes: The API key needs the candidatesWrite permission.

candidate_id.description: The id of the candidate to create a survey request for.

application_id.description: The id of the application to associate with the survey request.

survey_form_definition_id.description: The ID of the survey form that the candidate will see when they visit the URL returned in the surveyURL property of the API response. Survey forms IDs can be obtained using the surveyFormDefinition.list endpoint.

create_survey_submission.title: surveySubmission.create
create_survey_submission.description: Creates a survey submission for a candidate and application.
create_survey_submission.notes: The API key needs the candidatesWrite permission.

survey_form_definition_id.description: The unique identifier of the survey form definition to submit

candidate_id.description: The unique identifier of the candidate submitting the survey

application_id.description: The unique identifier of the associated application

submitted_values.description: A map of form field paths to submitted values

create_user_interviewer_pause.title: user.createInterviewerPause
create_user_interviewer_pause.description: Creates an interviewer pause for a user. While paused, the user will not be scheduled for interviews. A user can only have one interviewer pause at a time (whether active or scheduled). Attempting to create a pause when one already exists will return an error.
create_user_interviewer_pause.notes: The API key needs the organizationWrite permission.

user_id.description: The id of the user to pause.

starts_at.description: The start date and time of the pause. Defaults to the current time if not provided.

ends_at.description: The end date and time of the pause. If not provided, the pause is indefinite.

comment.description: An optional comment describing the reason for the pause.

create_webhook.title: webhook.create
create_webhook.description: Creates a webhook setting. Calls Ashby's webhook.create endpoint.
create_webhook.notes: The API key needs the apiKeysWrite permission.

request_url.description: The URL the webhook will send requests to

secret_token.description: The secret token used to sign the webhook request. See our documentation here for more information.

delete_application.title: application.delete
delete_application.description: Deletes an application by id. Calls Ashby's application.delete endpoint.
delete_application.notes: The API key needs the candidatesDelete permission.

application_id.description: The unique identifier for the application to delete

delete_email_sync_blocked_address.title: emailSyncBlockedAddress.delete
delete_email_sync_blocked_address.description: Removes email addresses from the candidate email sync blocklist. Addresses must match a listed entry exactly. Removing an address that is not on the list succeeds and is omitted from removedAddresses.
delete_email_sync_blocked_address.notes: The API key needs the organizationWrite permission.

addresses.description: The email addresses to remove from the blocklist. Matching is exact, and addresses that are not on the list are ignored.

delete_referral.title: referral.delete
delete_referral.description: Deletes a referral submission by id. The referralId is the id returned by referral.list. The optional clearAttribution field controls whether attribution is also removed from the associated application: - None is the default and deletes only the referral. - CreditedToUser clears the credited user.
delete_referral.notes: The API key needs the candidatesDelete permission.

referral_id.description: The unique identifier for the referral to delete, from referral.list

clear_attribution.description: Controls which application attribution fields are cleared when they still belong to this referral. Use CreditedToUser to remove the candidate from the employee's Referral dashboard while preserving Referral as the source.

delete_user_interviewer_pause.title: user.deleteInterviewerPause
delete_user_interviewer_pause.description: Deletes an interviewer pause. Calls Ashby's user.deleteInterviewerPause endpoint.
delete_user_interviewer_pause.notes: The API key needs the organizationWrite permission.

interviewer_pause_id.description: The id of the interviewer pause to delete.

delete_webhook.title: webhook.delete
delete_webhook.description: Deletes a webhook setting. Calls Ashby's webhook.delete endpoint.
delete_webhook.notes: The API key needs the apiKeysWrite permission.

webhook_id.description: The id of the webhook setting to delete

discard_sequence.title: sequence.discard
discard_sequence.description: Permanently discards a NotStarted sourcing sequence draft owned by the acting user. Drafts created with x-on-behalf-of must be discarded using the same user. Repeating a successful discard is safe. A sequence ID that is absent from the acting organization is treated as already discarded and returns success; this response does not indicate whether the sequence previously existed.
discard_sequence.notes: The API key needs the sourcingWrite permission.

sequence_id.description: The unique identifier for the draft sequence enrollment

fetch_custom_field_values.title: customFields.fetch
fetch_custom_field_values.description: The API for listing custom fields that can be synced to Ashby — implemented by the assessment partner, but called by Ashby. This endpoint is optional. Ashby only calls it for integrations that have custom field sync enabled by Ashby. Contact Ashby if you wish to use this feature.

generate_report.title: report.generate
generate_report.description: Generates a new report or polls the status of an existing report generation. Two-step process: 1. Call with only reportId to start generation and receive a requestId. 2. Poll with both reportId and requestId every second until status is complete or failed.
generate_report.notes: The API key needs the reportsRead permission.

include_headers_in_data.description: When true (default), column headers are included as the first row in the data array. When false, headers are only in the columnNames property.

result_style.description: How completed report data is returned. "inline" (default) embeds the data in the response; "url" returns a short-lived presigned S3 download URL instead. Requires includeHeadersInData to be true (or omitted) when "url".

request_id.description: Request ID for polling existing report generation status.

get_api_key_info.title: apiKey.info
get_api_key_info.description: Returns details for the API key used to make the request.
get_api_key_info.notes: The API key needs the apiKeysRead permission.

get_application.title: application.info
get_application.description: Fetch application details by application id or by submitted form instance id (which is returned by the applicationForm.submit endpoint). If both applicationId and submittedFormInstanceId are provided, the lookup uses applicationId.
get_application.notes: The API key needs the candidatesRead permission.

application_id.description: The id of the application to fetch.

submitted_form_instance_id.description: The id of the application's submitted form instance to fetch. Either applicationId or submittedFormInstanceId must be provided. When both are supplied, the lookup uses applicationId.

expand.description: Choose to expand the result and include additional data for related objects.

get_candidate.title: candidate.info
get_candidate.description: Fetches details about a single candidate by id or external mapping id.

start_offer.notes: The API key needs the offersWrite permission.

offer_process_id.description: The ID of the offer process to start. This value is the id included in the response of the offerProcess.start API.

start_offer_approval_process.title: offer.startApprovalProcess
start_offer_approval_process.description: Starts the approval process for an offer in a "WaitingOnApprovalStart" state. Once started, the approval is sent to the configured approvers. The offer version ID can be obtained from the offer (e.g. offer.info or offer.list response's latestVersion.id).
start_offer_approval_process.notes: The API key needs the offersWrite permission.

offer_version_id.description: The id of the offer version whose approval process should be started

note.description: Optional note to attach to the approval request

exclude_form_definition.description: If true, omit the form definition from the response.

start_offer_process.title: offerProcess.start
start_offer_process.description: Starts an offer process for a candidate.
start_offer_process.notes: The API key needs the offersWrite permission.

application_id.description: The id of the application to start an offer process for

start_sequence.title: sequence.start
start_sequence.description: Validates and starts an existing NotStarted sourcing sequence draft owned by the acting user. Drafts created with x-on-behalf-of must be started with the same acting user. Validation errors and required actions return a structured Blocked startResult and leave the sequence NotStarted and editable. Warnings and informational entries do not block starting.
start_sequence.notes: The API key needs the sourcingWrite permission.

sequence_id.description: The unique identifier for the draft sequence enrollment

submit_application_feedback.title: applicationFeedback.submit
submit_application_feedback.description: Application feedback forms support a variety of field types. The values accepted for each field depend on the type of field that's being filled out: - Boolean - A boolean value - CompensationRange - An object in the format { type: "compensation-range", minValue: 100000, maxValue: 150000, currencyCode: "USD", interval: "1 YEAR" }.
submit_application_feedback.notes: The API key needs the candidatesWrite permission.

feedback_form.description: The application feedback form data containing field submissions

form_definition_id.description: The id of the feedback form definition associated with the form submission

application_id.description: The id of the application you're submitting feedback for

user_id.description: The id of the user the feedback will be credited to. If omitted, the feedback will be credited to the API key user.

interview_event_id.description: The id of the interview event you're submitting feedback for

submit_application_form.title: applicationForm.submit
submit_application_form.description: Submits a completed application form for a job posting. See Creating a Custom Careers Page for the full flow.
submit_application_form.notes: The API key needs the candidatesWrite permission.

job_posting_id.description: The id of the job posting to submit the application for

application_form.description: The application form data containing field submissions

tag_ids.description: Optional array of tag ids to apply to the candidate

allow_submission_for_unpublished_job_pos.description: If false, applications for unpublished job postings will be rejected. Defaults to true.

transfer_application.title: application.transfer
transfer_application.description: Transfer an application to a different job.
transfer_application.notes: The API key needs the candidatesWrite permission.

application_id.description: The id of the application to transfer.

job_id.description: The id of the job to transfer the application to.

interview_plan_id.description: The id of the interview plan to transfer the application to.

interview_stage_id.description: The interview stage of the interview plan to transfer the application to.

start_automatic_activities.description: Whether to start any automatic activities set on the target interview stage. Defaults to true when omitted.

update_application.title: application.update
update_application.description: Update an application. To set values for custom fields on Applications, use the customField.setValue endpoint.
update_application.notes: The API key needs the candidatesWrite permission.

application_id.description: The id of the application to update.

source_id.description: The source to set on the application. Pass null to unset an application's source.

credited_to_user_id.description: The id of the user the application will be credited to. Pass null to unset an application's credited user.

created_at.description: An ISO date string to set the application's createdAt timestamp. When provided, the first history event's enteredStageAt is updated to match.

send_notifications.description: Whether users subscribed to the application should be notified that the application was updated. Defaults to true.

update_application_history.title: application.updateHistory
update_application_history.description: Update the history of an application. Used to update stage timestamps and to delete history events. Also requires the Allow updating application history? setting found in your admin API key permissions configuration.
update_application_history.notes: The API key needs the candidatesWrite permission.

application_id.description: The id of the application whose history to update.

application_history.description: The updated array of application history events. This array should contain all history events for the application, not just the events being updated.

update_approval_definition.title: approvalDefinition.update
update_approval_definition.description: Create or update an approval definition for a specific entity that requires approval. The entity requiring approval must be within scope of an approval in Ashby that is marked as being managed by the API. If the provided approval step definitions is an empty list, then approval will be skipped and the entity will proceed to the next stage.
update_approval_definition.notes: The API key needs the approvalsWrite permission.

entity_type.description: The type of approval entity being updated.

entity_id.description: The id of the approval entity being updated, such as the id of the offer version.

approval_step_definitions.description: An ordered list of approval steps that describes the number of required approvers at each step, as well as who is an approver at each step.

submit_approval_request.description: Control whether an approval request created through this API should be immediately submitted. If false, then the approval will need to be manually submitted in the Ashby app. Defaults to false.

update_assessment.title: assessment.update
update_assessment.description: Update Ashby about the status of a started assessment. assessment_status is required unless cancelled_reason is provided.
update_assessment.notes: The API key needs the candidatesWrite permission.

assessment_id.description: Identifier of the assessment being updated

timestamp.description: The timestamp in milliseconds since the unix epoch when the assessment update occurred

assessment_status.description: The current status of the assessment. Setting this with a value of "Started" will signal Ashby to store the timestamp the assessment started. Required when cancelled_reason is not set.

assessment_profile_url.description: The url back to the assessment/candidate on the partner's website. This value should always be of type url. Required when assessment_result is set.

assessment_result.description: The result of the assessment. Sending an update with this field will signal to Ashby that the assessment is complete.

cancelled_reason.description: The reason the assessment was cancelled. This field will signal to Ashby that the assessment is cancelled.

metadata.description: Any other metadata about the assessment (e.g. ETA until complete). All assessment data should have unique identifiers.

update_candidate.title: candidate.update
update_candidate.description: Updates an existing candidate. Calls Ashby's candidate.update endpoint.
update_candidate.notes: The API key needs the candidatesWrite permission.

candidate_id.description: The unique id of the candidate to update

name.description: The first and last name of the candidate to update

email.description: Primary, personal email of the candidate to update

phone_number.description: Primary, personal phone number of the candidate to update

linked_in_url.description: Url to the candidate's LinkedIn profile. Must be a valid Url.

github_url.description: Url to the candidate's Github profile. Must be a valid Url.

website_url.description: Url of the candidate's website. Must be a valid Url.

alternate_email.description: An alternate email address to add to the candidate's profile

social_links.description: An array of social links to set on the candidate. This value replaces existing socialLinks that have been set on the candidate. If this value is submitted along with linkedInUrl, gitHubUrl or websiteUrl fields, those values will be ignored.

source_id.description: The id of source for this candidate. Pass null to unset the candidate's source.

credited_to_user_id.description: The id of the user the candidate will be credited to. Pass null to unset the candidate's credited user.

created_at.description: An ISO date string to set the candidate's createdAt timestamp

send_notifications.description: Whether or not users who are subscribed to the candidate should be notified that the candidate was updated. Default is true.

update_custom_field_selectable_values.title: customField.updateSelectableValues
update_custom_field_selectable_values.description: Update the selectable values for a custom field. This endpoint merges the provided selectable values with the existing values for a custom field.
update_custom_field_selectable_values.notes: The API key needs the hiringProcessMetadataWrite permission.

custom_field_id.description: The id of the custom field to update

selectable_values.description: An array of selectable values to merge with the existing values. Only label, value, and optionally isArchived should be provided.

update_department.title: department.update
update_department.description: Updates a department. Calls Ashby's department.update endpoint.
update_department.notes: The API key needs the organizationWrite permission.

name.description: The name of the department or team

external_name.description: An alternate candidate-facing name for this department that will be used on Ashby job boards

extra_data.description: Key-value pairs for your own use and reference. Keys must be at most 100 characters, values at most 512 characters, and total size less than 1kb.

update_interview_schedule.title: interviewSchedule.update
update_interview_schedule.description: Update an interview schedule. This endpoint allows you to add, cancel, or update interview events associated with an interview schedule. In order to update an interview event on a schedule, the event's interviewEventId must be included when sending your request. interviewEventIds are included in the response of the interviewSchedule.create endpoint.
update_interview_schedule.notes: The API key needs the interviewsWrite permission.

interview_schedule_id.description: The id of the interview schedule to update. Only interview schedules created using the API key making the request can be updated.

interview_event.description: An event (or array of events) on the interview schedule to create or update. To update an event, its interviewEventId must be included in the request.

interview_event_id_to_cancel.description: The id (or array of ids) of interview events to cancel.

allow_feedback_deletion.description: By default, events with submitted feedback cannot be cancelled because cancellation deletes the associated feedback. Pass true to allow cancelling events with submitted feedback.

update_interviewer_pool.title: interviewerPool.update
update_interviewer_pool.description: Update an interviewer pool. Calls Ashby's interviewerPool.update endpoint.
update_interviewer_pool.notes: The API key needs the hiringProcessMetadataWrite permission.

interviewer_pool_id.description: The id of the interviewer pool to update

title.description: The title of the interviewer pool

requires_training.description: Whether the interviewer pool requires training

update_job.title: job.update
update_job.description: Updates an existing job. At least one field other than jobId must be supplied.
update_job.notes: The API key needs the jobsWrite permission.

job_id.description: The unique id of the job to update

title.description: A new title for the job

team_id.description: The new team to associate with the job. Pass null (together with another field to update) to remove the existing team.

location_id.description: The new location to associate with the job

default_interview_plan_id.description: The new default interview plan to associate with the job

employment_type.description: The new employment type for the job

custom_requisition_id.description: The new custom requisition id for the job. Pass null (together with another field to update) to clear the existing value.

update_job_compensation.title: job.updateCompensation
update_job_compensation.description: Replaces the compensation tiers on a job. Pass an empty array to clear existing compensation.
update_job_compensation.notes: The API key needs the jobsWrite permission.

job_id.description: The unique id of the job to update

compensation_tiers.description: The compensation tiers to set on the job. Pass an empty array to clear existing compensation.

update_job_compensation_settings.title: job.updateCompensationSettings
update_job_compensation_settings.description: Updates compensation display settings for a job. Controls whether and how compensation is shown on job boards and postings for this specific job. Each field uses the null-means-inherit convention: - Omitted: leaves the current setting untouched. - Explicit null: clears the job-level override so the value inherits from the parent brand. - Any other value: sets a job-level override.
update_job_compensation_settings.notes: The API key needs the jobsWrite permission.

job_id.description: The unique id of the job whose compensation display settings to update

should_show_on_job_board.description: Whether compensation should appear on the job board listing. Omit to leave unchanged. Pass null to clear the override and inherit from the brand.

should_show_on_job_postings.description: Whether compensation should appear on individual job postings. Omit to leave unchanged. Pass null to clear the override and inherit from the brand. Note: organization-level pay transparency settings can force this on regardless.

compensation_tier_guide_url.description: A URL explaining the compensation tiers. Omit to leave unchanged. Pass null to clear the override and inherit from the brand.

compensation_philosophy.description: The compensation philosophy as a { type, value } object using text/plain or text/html. Omit to leave unchanged. Pass null to clear the override and inherit from the brand.

update_job_posting.title: jobPosting.update
update_job_posting.description: Updates an existing job posting. Set includeUnpublishedJobPostings to true when updating an unpublished (draft) job posting. This flag is required for draft postings; published postings can be updated without it.
update_job_posting.notes: The API key needs the jobsWrite permission.

job_posting_id.description: The unique id of the job posting to update

title.description: A new title for the job posting

suppress_description_opening.description: When true, the job description opening from the brand will be suppressed. descriptionOpening will be returned as null.

suppress_description_closing.description: When true, the job description closing from the brand will be suppressed. descriptionClosing will be returned as null.

description.description: An HTML block of the job posting description

application_confirmation_email_template_.description: The id of the email template to use for application confirmation emails on this posting. Pass null to clear the posting-level override and fall back to organization defaults.

location_id.description: The id of the location to set as the primary location for the job posting. Pass null to clear the posting-level location override so the posting falls back to the parent job's location.

secondary_location_ids.description: A full replacement of the secondary locations for the job posting. Pass an empty array to clear all secondary locations.

application_form_definition_id.description: The id of the application form definition to use for this posting. Pass null to clear the posting-level override and fall back to the organization default form.

job_board_associations.description: A full replacement of the Ashby-hosted job boards associated with this posting. Pass an empty array to remove the posting from every Ashby-hosted job board. Omit to leave associations unchanged.

include_unpublished_job_postings.description: When true, allows updating unpublished (draft) job postings. Required when updating a draft posting.

update_job_posting_compensation.title: jobPosting.updateCompensation
update_job_posting_compensation.description: Updates compensation for an existing job posting. Set includeUnpublishedJobPostings to true when updating an unpublished (draft) job posting. This flag is required for draft postings; published postings can be updated without it. Pass a non-empty compensationTiers array to replace the posting's compensation and stop inheriting compensation from the parent job.
update_job_posting_compensation.notes: The API key needs the jobsWrite permission.

job_posting_id.description: The unique id of the job posting to update

compensation_tiers.description: The compensation tiers to set on the job posting. Pass null to reset the posting to inherit compensation from the parent job.

include_unpublished_job_postings.description: When true, allows updating compensation for unpublished (draft) job postings. Required when updating a draft posting.

update_job_posting_compensation_settings.title: jobPosting.updateCompensationSettings
update_job_posting_compensation_settings.description: Updates compensation display settings for a job posting. Controls whether and how compensation is shown for this specific posting. Each field uses the null-means-inherit convention: - Omitted: leaves the current setting untouched. - Explicit null: clears the posting-level override so the value inherits from the parent job. - Any other value: sets a posting-level override.
update_job_posting_compensation_settings.notes: The API key needs the jobsWrite permission.

job_posting_id.description: The unique id of the job posting whose compensation display settings to update

should_show_on_job_board.description: Whether compensation should appear on the job board listing for this posting. Omit to leave unchanged. Pass null to clear the override and inherit from the parent job.

should_show_on_job_postings.description: Whether compensation should appear on this posting's detail page. Omit to leave unchanged. Pass null to clear the override and inherit from the parent job. Note: organization-level pay transparency settings can force this on regardless.

compensation_tier_guide_url.description: A URL explaining the compensation tiers. Omit to leave unchanged. Pass null to clear the override and inherit from the parent job.

compensation_philosophy.description: The compensation philosophy as a { type, value } object using text/plain or text/html. Omit to leave unchanged. Pass null to clear the override and inherit from the parent job.

include_unpublished_job_postings.description: When true, allows updating an unpublished (draft) job posting. Required when updating a draft posting.

update_location_address.title: location.updateAddress
update_location_address.description: Update an address of a location or location hierarchy.
update_location_address.notes: The API key needs the organizationWrite permission.

address.description: The address of the location. Pass null to clear.

update_location_external_name.title: location.updateExternalName
update_location_external_name.notes: The API key needs the organizationWrite permission.

external_name.description: An alternate candidate-facing name for this location used on job boards and in the API. Pass null to clear.

update_location_name.title: location.updateName
update_location_name.description: Update location's name. Calls Ashby's location.updateName endpoint.
update_location_name.notes: The API key needs the organizationWrite permission.

update_location_workplace_type.title: location.updateWorkplaceType
update_location_workplace_type.description: Update location's workplace type. Calls Ashby's location.updateWorkplaceType endpoint.
update_location_workplace_type.notes: The API key needs the organizationWrite permission.

workplace_type.description: The type of workplace. LocationHierarchies cannot be labeled with a workplaceType.

update_offer.title: offer.update
update_offer.description: Updates an existing Offer Offer forms support a variety of field types. The values accepted for each field depend on the type of field that's being filled out: - Boolean - A boolean value. - Currency - An object in the format { currencyCode: "USD", value: 100000 } where currencyCode is a valid ISO 4217 currency code and value is an integer. - Date - A valid ISO Date string. - Number - An integer.
update_offer.notes: The API key needs the offersWrite permission.

offer_id.description: The id of the offer you're updating.

offer_form.description: The form submission for the offer. Can be retrieved from offer.info.

exclude_form_definition.description: If true, omit the form definition from the response.

update_opening.title: opening.update
update_opening.description: Updates an opening. To set values for custom fields on Openings, use the customField.setValue endpoint.
update_opening.notes: The API key needs the jobsWrite permission.

opening_id.description: The id of the opening to update

identifier.description: The human-readable identifier of the opening

team_id.description: The id of the department or team associated with the opening

target_hire_date.description: The date (in YYYY-MM-DD format) by which you intend to hire against this opening

target_start_date.description: The date (in YYYY-MM-DD format) by which you intend someone hired against this opening will start employment

is_backfill.description: Whether this opening is intended to backfill a previous employee

employment_type.description: The employment type for this opening

update_project.title: project.update
update_project.description: Beta This endpoint is in beta and may not be available for all organizations. Updates a project's title or description, including archived projects. Requires at least one editable field. Omitted fields remain unchanged; null or empty descriptions clear the existing content. The effective actor must have permission to edit the project, including for authorized on-behalf-of requests.
update_project.notes: The API key needs the projectsWrite permission.

project_id.description: The id of the project to update.

description.description: Omit to preserve the description. Null or empty content clears it. Plain-text whitespace is preserved.

update_sequence_stage.title: sequence.updateStage
update_sequence_stage.description: Replaces the supplied subject or HTML body of one email stage in a not-started sourcing sequence. At least one of subject or body is required. The reusable sequence template is not changed. Subject is plain text. body uses the rich-text input shape { type: "text/html", value: "..." }.
update_sequence_stage.notes: The API key needs the sourcingWrite permission.

sequence_id.description: The unique identifier for the sequence enrollment

stage_id.description: The unique identifier for the email stage to update

subject.description: A plain-text subject that replaces the stage's current subject

body.description: The rich-text body that replaces the stage's current body

update_user_interviewer_settings.title: user.updateInterviewerSettings
update_user_interviewer_settings.description: Update interviewer settings for a user. Either limit can be provided, or both can be provided. If only one is provided, the other will remain unchanged. If a limit is provided but set to null, it will be unset.
update_user_interviewer_settings.notes: The API key needs the organizationWrite permission.

user_id.description: The id of the user to update interviewer settings for

daily_limit.description: Maximum number of interviews per day for this interviewer

weekly_limit.description: Maximum number of interviews per week for this interviewer

update_webhook.title: webhook.update
update_webhook.description: Updates a webhook setting. One of enabled, requestUrl, or secretToken must be provided.
update_webhook.notes: The API key needs the apiKeysWrite permission.

webhook_id.description: The id of the webhook setting to update

enabled.description: Whether or not the webhook setting is enabled

request_url.description: The URL the webhook will send requests to

secret_token.description: The secret token used to sign the webhook request. Pass null to clear. See our documentation here for more information.

upload_candidate_file.title: candidate.uploadFile
upload_candidate_file.description: Uploads a file for a candidate. Accepts either a multipart/form-data request with a file file part, or a JSON body with a fileHandle previously created via file.createFileUploadHandle.
upload_candidate_file.notes: The API key needs the candidatesWrite permission.

candidate_id.description: The id of the candidate

file_handle.description: A handle returned by file.createFileUploadHandle after uploading a file to the presigned URL.

upload_candidate_resume.title: candidate.uploadResume
upload_candidate_resume.description: Uploads a resume for a candidate. Accepts either a multipart/form-data request with a resume file part, or a JSON body with a resumeHandle previously created via file.createFileUploadHandle.
upload_candidate_resume.notes: The API key needs the candidatesWrite permission.

candidate_id.description: The id of the candidate

resume_handle.description: A handle returned by file.createFileUploadHandle after uploading a resume file to the presigned URL.
